criteria.photon_materials: Actual Photon/Faithful scene inspected: consistent blue-gray iron with brass fittings, normal darker shaded front, clear flanges on lit rear; no copper panel or unintended panel UV patches.
criteria.scale_readability: Shorter overall silhouette and horizontal barrel/end flanges visible; paired support feet and collared stack remain readable at ordinary distance.
criteria.states_motion: Stopped/startup/running and two working frames show coherent whole-wheel rotation. Rear flame reaches bulb and smoke originates at stack; feet stay clear.
criteria.interaction_guides: Oil Engine guide title and full revised loose-wheel preview match model; air requirement replaces old copper support. Existing coarse block-cell collision retained.
criteria.inventory_appearance: Controller, cylinder and wheel fit hotbar slots; held controller and instrument panel retain recognizable appearance.
criteria.integration_limits: Standalone commissioning scene with Sable loaded; this does not verify engine aboard a vessel. No user-world edits made.
